name: More Colours
author: byo-pop examples
description: Up to eleven new coin colours: orange, cyan, silver, purple, brown, pink, charcoal, lime, teal, navy and maroon, each with a coin symbol unlike the colours it looks like. Six colours in every mode by default (the first level on Easy has one fewer, as in the game). More colours make big groups rarer, so the game gets harder. Keeps its own high scores.
